ctx.x: Was he really good in those days when he was a boy?

He was good. He was good. He was good. Well I'm telling you, he left here, he didn't have a music warning in his head when he left here. Then when Teor and them, Peter and them came back from Teor, he told me, he said, man sitting is up there writing numbers and composing numbers for a bottle of whiskey. Some of them fellas would come there and put them two-fifth whiskey on the table and tell him- Yeah, that's a company sure somebody- Says, man, pick up that soprano, let me hear you knock that number. And he…

Ralph, do you have to call up anybody? Yeah, I should think. I'm in the full call. What time is that? About 4.30? We didn't want to take your whole afternoon, but- That's another one of mine. Oh, this is another waltz. Yeah, acceptable waltz.
